==Biography==
Touch started playing League of Legends because of his friends. They started attending LAN events in Norway and won each of them. In season 3 he met [[HolyPhoenix]] in soloqueue, they played a lot of duoqueue after that together. 

In season 4, [[Dark Passage]] needed a support for the [[2014 Season International Wild Card Tournament]] and Touch went to join them and won the International Wild Card Tournement and went to [[2014_Season_World_Championship|2014 Season World Championship]]. They got in group with [[AHQ e-Sports Club]], [[EDward Gaming]] and [[Samsung White]], which they lost 0-6.

== Trivia ==
* Favorite food is pizza
* Played at [[Worlds 2014]] for [[Dark Passage]].
* Looks up to [[Mata]] as a player.
* Finished as a runner-up in the Norwegian version of [[wikipedia:Love Island (franchise)|Love Island]] in 2020.<ref>[https://loveisland.fandom.com/wiki/Omid_Rosander Omid Rosander - Love Island Wiki] ''loveisland.fandom.com''</ref><ref>[https://www.tv2.no/a/11159104/ Love Island-Omid (24) er fire ganger norgesmester: – Folk tror ikke det om meg (Norwegian)] ''tv2.no''</ref>
